# Daifuku

> Daifuku opens coding agent terminals in a grid in Windows Terminal and colours each window's border by what its agent is doing.

Windows 10 and 11, with Windows Terminal. Works with Claude Code and Codex through their hooks.
Border states: blue working, yellow waiting for the user, green done, red failed. Each state also has its own width.
Default hotkeys: Ctrl+Alt+Enter opens a fleet of six terminals, Ctrl+Alt+N focuses the agent that has waited longest, Ctrl+Alt+Backspace puts terminals back in their cells, Ctrl+Alt+F4 closes every fleet.
Install: download [daifuku.exe](/download/windows) and double-click it ([daifuku-arm64.exe](/download/windows-arm64) on ARM). It installs to C:\Program Files\Daifuku and starts at every sign-in.
Config: C:\ProgramData\Daifuku\daifuku.json, every key optional. `daifuku config` opens it, `daifuku doctor` checks the whole setup.

- [Daifuku skill (zip)](/skill/daifuku.zip): install, configure and troubleshoot Daifuku, and explain border colours
- [SKILL.md](/skill/daifuku/SKILL.md): the skill's instructions

- [Install and hooks](/skill/daifuku/references/install-and-hooks.md): what install changes, the hook entries, uninstall
- [Troubleshooting](/skill/daifuku/references/troubleshooting.md): reading `daifuku doctor`, files, logs, undo
